summary.text: Michelle McCane is a Democratic member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 72 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Michelle McCane was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

She earned a high school diploma from Booker T. Washington High School, an associate degree from Tulsa Community College in 2012, a bachelor's degree from Northeastern State University in 2014, and a graduate degree from Northeastern State University in 2018.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as educator and says that, as of 2024, she was affiliated with the Tulsa Classroom Teachers Association, Tulsa County Stonewall Democrats, the Tulsa County Democratic Party and Young Democrats of Oklahoma.
She took office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Monroe Nichols, and faces Adam Martin, a Republican, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
